title: $C^{1/5^{-}}$ Convex Integration Solutions of Ideal MHD
summary: For any $0\leq γ< 1/5$, we construct weak solutions $(v, B, p )$ of the Ideal MHD Equations which do not conserve the total kinetic energy, the cross-helicity and lie in $C^γ(\mathbb{T}^3\times\mathbb{R})$. In the spirit of Arnold's formulation of ideal hydrodynamics, a solution is thought of as a path of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms; the proof is then based on the interplay between classical convex integration techniques and geometric constructions at the level of the Lie algebra of this Lie group.
